angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 624,043 km at 95.55 pc = 0.09 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 10.4655 +/- 0.0183 mas (same row, RUWE 1.01): 95.55 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.897 +/- 0.013 solar radii from Fridlund et al. 2020, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-763 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020MNRAS.498.4503F/abstract): 624,043 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.917 +/- 0.028 solar masses from Fridlund et al. 2020, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-763 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020MNRAS.498.4503F/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5450 +/- 60 K from Fridlund et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-763 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020MNRAS.498.4503F/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Fridlund et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-763 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020MNRAS.498.4503F/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-763.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.495, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-763 (pscomppars): spectral type G, from Fridlund et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020MNRAS.498.4503F/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-763 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.01 dex, from Fridlund et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020MNRAS.498.4503F/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-763 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.15377, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6140553127216043648, flags_flame 00: age_flame 5.8122663 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 4.4543266 to 7.2220783)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-763 (pscomppars): rotation period 27 d, from Fridlund et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020MNRAS.498.4503F/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-763 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.7 km/s, from Fridlund et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020MNRAS.498.4503F/abstract)
